analysis:
The only changed lines in StandaloneServer.swift are around 562-567: the kvSweepTask closure now captures [weak self, kvBudget] and calls `await self?.retryShapeWarmups()` on each sweep tick. The supplied units (base text lines 1220-2271) contain no changed lines. I examined them as surrounding context: reslice/build, LRU eviction, acquireModel, ensureModelLoaded, and unwind paths. The security-relevant invariants in that code are unchanged. They include reservation guards against eviction, GLM unproven-retirement retention, weight-hash bracketing for cache eligibility, and pending-load leases.

The weak self capture avoids a retain cycle and does not extend the server's lifetime. The new retryShapeWarmups() is defined outside the supplied units, so I could not verify its behavior. Open questions for integration: (1) Does retryShapeWarmups take the isLoadingAny load gate or touch slots while a load or eviction is in flight? Unserialized warmups could overcommit unified memory (availability, T-029/TB-007) or race eviction. (2) Does it run during lifecycleDraining or stopping, or after native MiMo reclaim is disallowed (nativeMiMoReclaimAllowed)? (3) Does warmup execute inference on synthetic inputs only, with no consumer prompt data (A-001) retained, and does it avoid prefix-cache donation, which would interact with T-041? Nothing in the visible diff shows a regression, but that function body was not supplied, so I flag a limited-coverage caveat.
